p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, business start-up, investment platform: official information sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change frequently: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens up the official modern sources, then you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): For products and countries, customs, taxes, rules and procedures in one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): Duties and Rules of Origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): Standards, labelling and health regulations that the country has set for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access 2 Markets: Trade with and from the European Union, Step by Step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs and Customs Codes when entering the European Union
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): Starting a Business, Customs, International Trade, Country by Country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): Check that the website is not specified by the regulator before trusting it with money
p.espaces.rg_note: The website will open in its language: use your browser's translation or "Understand Documentation" for documentation. If you need to make a big decision, ask an expert in that country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Customs, Documentation, Incoterms, Free Official Tools, Forwarders and Carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not offer customs declaration: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): Duties and Rules for Nearly All Countries
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access 2 Market (EU): Customs, Duties, Rules of Origin, Step by Step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs Code (HS Code) and Customs Duty on Entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Shipping Documents: Customs Declaration (Sea), Air Certificate (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (business import or export in the European Union)
p.espaces.cu_d6: According to the product: Health or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standard
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything from seller’s factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the exported goods to the buyer’s carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: Seller loads on ship; then, risk and cost are of the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: Seller pays freight and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: The seller ships to the destination, the buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: Seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), certain drugs. The list is rejected and can be reported (ar).
p.espaces.cu_src: Source: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr. Check the correct regulations for your product every time.

p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without currency: Find suppliers, work out the real price, in the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling products that the supplier ships directly to your customer. Easy to start, but you still have the responsibility for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose products that are authorized for use in your customer’s country: No fraud, no control of unauthorized products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (“Wholesale / Supplier” list here or wholesale platform) and order samples before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Work out the real price: product, shipping, customs duties, VAT of the customer’s country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activity: business status, VAT and duties according to your country (see Trade Regulations).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect consumer rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: Providers who require full payment via unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: A costly course that promises to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Copyrighted photos and false reviews: prohibited and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, vehicles coming from outside the EU will have to pay VAT from the first euro.
